discussion_comments.comment_body: Thanks for flagging this. Here `this.config` is not the raw `RegistryEntry`: `XaiExecutor` receives `PROVIDERS[provider]`, and `generateLegacyProviders()` flattens `entry.oauth.clientIdEnv/clientIdDefault` into `p.clientId` and `entry.oauth.tokenUrl` into `p.tokenUrl` before the config reaches `BaseExecutor`. Therefore `this.config.clientId` and `this.config.tokenUrl` are the expected runtime fields; `ProviderConfig` has no nested `oauth` field. I verified that the generated `xai-oauth` config contains both values. Commit 549056099 adds an explicit assertion that refresh sends `XAI_OAUTH_CONFIG.clientId`; the focused suite passes 5/5 and `typecheck:core` passes.

Fixed in 0f319acb. Reordered applyConfigFilters so model-level operations run AFTER provider-level operations:
1. Provider denylist
2. Provider allowlist
3. Model denylist (overrides provider allowlist)
4. Model allowlist (most specific wins)

Added regression test verifying model denylist beats provider allowlist.

Done in b60a2c1e — probe URL now uses `process.env.OMNIROUTE_PORT || process.env.PORT || "20128"`, matching the pattern in `src/lib/runtime/ports.ts` and `fetchProviderModelsForSync` below. Thanks for catching that — we hardcoded 20128 in the initial draft and forgot to thread it through.

Good point. `URL.hostname` is already normalized to lowercase per the URL spec (WHATWG), so `new URL('http://LocalHost:8000').hostname` returns `'localhost'`. The hardcoded entries are already lowercase. For env var entries, adding `.toLowerCase()` would be a safe defensive measure — happy to add if requested.
Fixed in 7db280e — now validates with `Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0`, falls back to 86400s (24h) on invalid values.
